title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.1: build_context_2 ignores C_R and TH_2 (RFC 9528 method 0 violation)
description:
RFC 9528 Section 6.3.3.3 defines for EDHOC method 0: context_2 = [ ID_CRED_R, CRED_R, TH_2, C_R ]

The new 4-arg build_context_2 at edhoc.rs:485 accepts C_R and TH_2 as parameters but ignores them (prefixed with underscore), only encoding id_cred and cred. This means MAC_2 lacks the context binding to the specific transcript hash and connection identifier, which could allow signature replays across different EDHOC runs.

Same pattern applies to build_context_3 at edhoc.rs:492 - also accepts but ignores TH_3.
